text:
오늘도 코드 리뷰하면서 마우스 움직임이 자꾸 꼬여서 클릭이 안 될 때가 있잖아? 로지텍 리프트 버티컬는 손목을 크게 움직이지 않아도 포인터를 정확히 잡아줘서 화면 전환이 훨씬 부드러워. 처음엔 손에 익숙해지는 데 시간이 좀 걸릴 수 있지만, 금방 적응할 수 있어. 자세한 내용은 프로필에서 확인하고, 코드 101을 입력해봐.

이 게시물은 쿠팡 파트너스 활동의 일환으로, 이에 따른 일정액의 수수료를 제공받습니다.

reasons.hook: Starts with a relatable developer scenario that grabs attention.
reasons.persona_fit: Directly addresses Korean IT workers who code long hours.
reasons.purchase_intent: Highlights benefits but CTA is indirect, limiting purchase drive.
reasons.specificity: Mentions ergonomic benefit but lacks detailed specs or price info.
reasons.authenticity: Conversational tone feels genuine without exaggerated claims.
reasons.trust: Includes clear affiliate disclosure and no false statements.
reasons.cta_quality: CTA asks to check profile and enter a code, not a direct purchase link.
reasons.policy_safety: No prohibited content; disclosure meets policy requirements.
reasons.redundancy: Content is concise with no repeated ideas.

detected_risks: The claim that the mouse reduces wrist strain could be interpreted as a health claim and may attract additional review.
judge.improvement: Add a direct purchase link and include key specs (e.g., DPI, battery life) to strengthen purchase intent and specificity.
